title: Density and Compression on Lattice-Knot Merge Trees
summary: Ropelength is usually studied as a minimization problem for one knot at a time. We instead use ropelength to filter the space of all realizations of a knot type. For a knot type $K$ and a budget $Λ$, let $Y_Λ(K)$ be the space of unit-thickness $C^{1,1}$ configurations of length at most $Λ$, modulo rigid motions and constant-speed reparametrization. We prove compact capture for smooth knot families, yielding homotopical and homological exhaustion of the ordinary knot space by finite ropelength levels.
